items.title: Luke Schiro Interview, 1967-12-05
items.q: Just one night we were over at the Wittaginal on the Thursday night it was. And Lloyd Primer was looking for Fazzola...

ctx.x: Yeah, well, how did Fazzola get that nickname?

Well, from Lloyd Primer. Just one night we were over at the Wittaginal on the Thursday night it was. And Lloyd Primer was looking for Fazzola and someone said, he's over at the Wittaginal, he said, oh, you mean Fazzola? And let's see. The name of Fazzola is actually for Bean, it's Bean in Italian in the words. It's a Fabio Bean they call it. And Lloyd Primer took all of that in Fazzola because he took Fazzola music. He said the name stuck. So in the meantime, Fazz came back and he started to call Lloyd Feet.…
Is your right name Luke? Yeah, Luke. Your full name, what is that? Just Luke Skiro? No middle name right?
